name: CEO Daily WSJ & FT News Digest -- 3am-ET one-shot, Bright Data pull + GPT-5.4 cited-bullet summary, SES email to Austin
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-24: new ASTN macro (CEO-facing tools for Austin) + first project ASTN_WSJFT (path-safe for 'WSJ & FT'). A daily one-shot: at 3am ET, hit WSJ + FT via Bright Data, pull the top ~15-20 stories from each, run each through GPT-5.4 for a tight summary (1-line subtext of the 2-3 central points + 2-3 DIRECTLY-CITED bullet quotes), organize by section (Macroeconomics/Geopolitical/Equities/Debt/Corporate -- tune with Austin), and email the CEO via Amazon SES (Austin opted-in). Email format per article: "Headline" - 1-line subtext - 2-3 cited bullet quotes (actual article text) - article link; grouped by section header. THE FIDELITY GATE (Andrew hard-req: all directly citable, no inference/misquoting) = a MACHINE-VERIFIABLE verbatim-substring check (each bullet must be an exact normalized substring of the fetched article text; non-verbatim rejected/regenerated) -- provably-from-the-article, NOT trust-the-LLM (the session's grounding-discipline applied; CTO arch-gates it). One-shot (Andrew's lean), not a crawler: fixed section-listing URLs -> top-N article URLs -> article text. KEY OPEN ITEM: the Bright Data paywall-access method (subscription-entitled [preferred] vs Web-Unlocker) -- WSJ/FT are paywalled/anti-bot. LEGAL/ToS/copyright posture = Andrew-owned, SCTY-framed; design-mitigants baked in (verbatim-cited-quotes-only + headline+few-bullets-not-full-reproduction + link-back-attribution + single-internal-recipient = a personal executive clipping/brief, fair-use-leaning; fetch->summarize->email->discard, no content-lake). Tools: Bright Data (fetch) + GPT-5.4 (summarize+verbatim-gate) + Amazon SES (send) + EventBridge 3am-ET cron + a one-shot Lambda/Fargate; secrets in Secrets Manager, Terraform-managed.
